name: NYC Fish Rescue
region_note: FISH & AQUATIC (aquarium fish, goldfish, bettas; aquatic turtles are under reptiles)
notes: A NYC volunteer network (~1,100+ followers) that re-homes fish that are unwanted or can no longer be cared for, and will pick up the fish and tank/equipment. Fills a category with essentially no formal rescue. NEVER flush or release aquarium fish (goldfish especially become invasive and harm waterways). Confirm current activity via the Facebook page; also try aquarium-society and hobbyist groups for species-specific rehoming. Phone: (via Facebook page) Email: (via Facebook Messenger) Intake: Message NYC Fish Rescue on Facebook to rehome fish you can no longer keep - they will come collect the fish and equipment Other channel: Facebook: NYC Fish Rescue
status_note: It has only a Facebook page. Message it there before bringing fish, to check it is still taking them.
